steps.npc: Oh umm, no and yes. I'm forever observing, you see.
Oh, erm, birds! Yes, those feathery little flittery things.

steps.player: Yes, I know what a bird is.

steps.npc: Do you though? The subtleties between different species of birds is quite incredible, you see-

steps.player: But how could I attract them? Y'know, so I could observe them a little closer.

steps.npc: Ah yes, well, of course! I've travelled around this island and found the best spots for bird watching. I placed a ring of stones at these locations!

steps.player: So those would be the best locations to place my traps...

steps.npc: Traps?! Preposterous! These fine exotic Birds are to be watched and not harmed in any way!

steps.player: Did I say traps? Oh, I meant, umm, feeding them! Yes! I could feed them.

steps.npc: You should not interfere with the birds, just watch, no feeding them anything! Not even seeds!
Yes, well, perhaps a bit! There are new exotic birds everywhere on this island! I guess I'm getting a little over-excited.

steps.player: Yeah, there sure are a lot of birds... For now.

steps.npc: It's my fathers fault entirely, constantly talking about falconry...

steps.player: Your father is a hunter? Does he know anything about hunting birds?

steps.npc: Umm, well of course, falcons ARE hunting birds, they mostly catch varying types of kebbits, it's rather mundane.
...Oh, you're still here. What was that? Oh yes, bye for now!
